title: Public-data reconstruction of the fixed NRRS
question: Can the published eight-gene score be computed in the public GSE62254 gastric cohort and reproduce the reported survival direction under an explicit transform and cutoff?
comparison: continuous NRRS and prespecified high versus low grouping
claim_ceiling: analysis reproduction and retrospective association only
falsifier: the score cannot be computed under the locked reconstruction or its adverse survival direction is not reproduced in GSE62254
science_basis: The bounded reconstruction is patient-level, uses an explicit score contract, and does not mislabel GSE62254 as untouched external validation.
estimated_calendar_time: completed; a clean rerun should take under one day after dependencies and downloads
stop_condition: stop if no defensible transform and cutoff can be fixed or public survival fields cannot be parsed
